lines.text: What'll it be? I'll have it done in a jiffy!
There's nothing mightier than Raze & Rebuild!
If there are any malfunctions or broken parts, let me know!
It's a pleasure to work with you!
Boss! Are the loans all taken care of?
Business is booming, thanks to you!
Is the Boss not here? I better get to work then, lots to do.

Boss! When are you coming? We gotta get to work. 
There's much to be done with the class manager.
This outpost needs to be reworked from the ground up... I love it!
Pretty cool workshop, huh? Built it ourselves!
Is that a broken part over there? I'm on it!
Saw teeth... entire buildings... you name it, I can make it for you, and fast!
Getting closer to completion!
Woo-hoo! My power is increasing!
I feel like I could build a skyscraper in the blink of an eye!
Wait, this isn't a mission letter... Is this a gift?
So you were thinking about me? Thanks!
Just for me? This means so much to me!
My heart seems to be beating faster lately... Hope it's not a malfunction...
I feel just like I do whenever we finish constructing a building.

All these strange emotions I've been feeling... they make my heart race.
If only you could repair emotions!
Where is the next site?
Just name a troop!
I'm going!
Let's do this!
Looks there's a lot to repair!
Destruction is also my specialty!
Let's roll!
Reloaded!
Excuse me!
Be back in a second!
I'm ready!
Raze & Rebuild are all-powerful tools!
Now! Fight to the death!!
Gotcha!
I did it!
See?
That hurt!
Ugh!
Gah!
Sorry, if you will excuse me.
Is it enough for fighting?

favorite.name: Metal Pendant
favorite.description:
Even a workaholic who lives in her workshop can't escape love when it comes knocking.
A first gift for someone may be rough around the edges, but that's what makes it pure and precious.
